The 120 Basics redrawn with generator v2

For the owner's final review. Names, IDs, types, positions, sizes, colours (one documented exception) and attribute profiles are unchanged, the 102 original forms are untouched, and nothing is wired into the game data yet. The current Basic art (baseline commit 6abcf3b) is the "before" throughout.
